title: Concept: Environment file contents disclosed in a response
description: The response served a framework environment file containing the APP_KEY and APP_ENV entries. That file holds the key that signs cookies and encrypted values plus the database and mail credentials, so reading it is equivalent to reading the deployment secrets.
applicability: Responses that return a dotenv file from the document root.
risk: Application secrets are readable in plain text; HIGH severity because the key material is directly usable.
